global_programme_gates.requirement: All persisted human decimal inputs use exact checked decimal-to-integer scaling; floating-point scale-and-truncate conversion is forbidden.
On-demand sync is unique-work serialized and every transport send requires a successful atomic leased outbox claim; expired leases remain recoverable.
Explicit user sign-out attempts Supabase server session revocation with local scope and always clears local credentials; authorization-loss clearing remains local-only.
Repository ships the standard Gradle 9.3.1 wrapper and verifies the Gradle distribution SHA-256; CI and local Android scripts execute through ./gradlew.
Canonical CI must assemble a non-empty debug APK from the wrapper-driven build and hash the resulting artifact.
Every GitHub Action reference in canonical workflows is pinned to an immutable 40-character commit SHA.
Pull reconciliation, local ops mutation orchestration and shared data helpers are separate bounded source units with CI no-growth ceilings.
